title: Private School Checklist for Hosting JSS Form
text:
CHECKLIST FOR AUDITING THE PRIVATE SCHOOLS PREPAREDNESS TO
 OFFER JUNIOR SECONDARY SCHOOLS
1.0 INSTITUTIONAL BIO- DATA:
 1.1 School Name: _____________________________________
 1.2 County: ______________________________
 1.3 Sub- County: _________________________________
 1.4 Type of School:
 A) Boys B) Girls C) Mixed
 1.5 School Set- up Envisaged:
 A) Stand- Alone JSS
 B) Primary and JSS
 C) JSS and SSS
 D) Whole School
2.0 JSS CURRICULUM
What are the preferred (three minimum) JSS Optional Subjects?
 2.1 ____________________________________________
 2.2 ____________________________________________
 2.3 ____________________________________________
3.0 JSS INFRASTRUCTURE
Specify whether: YES NO
 3.1 The site is free from environmental and security
 hazards:
 3.2 Adequate land is provided (0.5 acres for urban,
 1acre for rural high density and 4 acres for rural
 low-density areas).
 3.3 There is a Public Works approved site plan.
 3.4 There is a valid title deed/lease agreement for
 the land and buildings.
 3.5 There are infrastructure approvals from relevant
 regulatory bodies (County Gov, NCA, NEMA).
 3.6 Certificate of completion and certificate of
 occupancy are provided for new infrastructure.
 3.7 The school has:
 3.7.1 At least 2 surplus classrooms.
 3.7.2 At least one Science laboratory.
 3.7.3 Workshops for the Pre- Technical Studies.
 3.7.4 Special rooms for the optional subjects.
 3.7.5 Relevant safety equipment tools and
 materials (for the curriculum envisaged):
 3.7.6 Gardening space for Agriculture
 3.7.7 Adequate and suitable (age appropriate)
 furniture.
 3.7.8 Adequate, consistent safe water supply.
 3.7.9 Adequate age appropriate sanitation
 facilities @ the ratio of 1:25 for girls plus a
 bathroom and 1:30 for boys plus a urinal
 3.7.10 Separate sanitation facilities for staff, at
 least one for each gender.
 3.7.11 Adequate games facilities for the
 projected enrolments.
4.0 HUMAN RESOURCE
Specify whether the following are enlisted to support the various
learning areas envisaged:
 4.1 Adequate and qualified teaching staff:
 Yes No
 4.2 Adequate and qualified technical support staff:
 Yes No
